lines.say: The final count, according to court documents and trial evidence: more than seventy victims, and more than six million dollars lost.
lines.show: The final count, according to court documents and trial evidence: more than 70 victims, and more than $6 million lost.

scene.title: More than $6 million
scene.src: U.S. Attorney's Office, N.D. Tex., press release (Nov 20, 2026)

lines.say: Garcia faces up to twenty years in federal prison on each count. Sentencing is set for March fourth, twenty twenty-seven.
lines.show: Garcia faces up to 20 years in federal prison on each count. Sentencing is set for March 4, 2027.

scene.title: Sentencing: March 4, 2027
scene.src: U.S. Attorney's Office, N.D. Tex., press release (Nov 20, 2026)

lines.say: And the case may not be finished. The F.B.I. is still asking people who think they were victims to come forward, through an online questionnaire, in English and in Spanish.
lines.show: And the case may not be finished. The FBI is still asking people who think they were victims to come forward, through an online questionnaire, in English and in Spanish.

scene.title: The FBI is still looking
scene.src: U.S. Attorney's Office, N.D. Tex., press release (Nov 20, 2026)

lines.say: Three churches that, according to the government's chart, were never bought. Donations that were really investments. And, according to the government's own charts, a pastor's personal account that paid Mercedes-Benz.
lines.show: Three churches that, according to the government's chart, were never bought. Donations that were really investments. And, according to the government's own charts, a pastor's personal account that paid Mercedes-Benz.

scene.kicker: UNITED STATES v. GARCIA · N.D. TEX.

lines.say: The judge will decide his sentence in March. What sentence do you think he should get? Tell us in the comments.
